Definition
[Sheets of a covering space]

↗ def:covering-space \group Covering Spaces

For an evenly covered connected open $U\subset X$, the components of $p^{-1}(U)$ mapped homeomorphically to $U$ are the sheets over $U$. Their number is $|p^{-1}(x)|$, independent of $x\in U$, and constant when $X$ is connected.

For $S^1\vee S^1$, coverings can be represented by 2-oriented graphs; the finite case follows from an Eulerian circuit argument and the infinite case from \cite{Konig1990}.
